Class NotebookDip

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.NotebookDip
final class NotebookDip extends Object
The NotebookDip class asks for one settled token count after the text stops changing. The call is POST to the URL in HOST. The model id is MODEL. num_predict is 1. The reply text is not kept. prompt_eval_count is the count. A failed call returns 0, and NotebookDip.Seat.settled(int) is not called, so the estimate stays in place. Text longer than MAX_CHARS characters is not sent. This type does not paint.

  • Method Details

    • watch

      void watch(String text)
      The method arms a settle for this text. A null text is stored as empty. The same text as the pending text does not re-arm the timer. An empty text stops the timer. Text longer than MAX_CHARS stops the timer. Any other change bumps the generation and restarts the 700 millisecond timer.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the line or the counted body, and it may be null.

    • fire

      private void fire()
      The method starts a daemon thread named ollama-token-dip. Empty text returns without a call. Text longer than MAX_CHARS returns without a call. The thread reads the count off the Swing event thread. NotebookDip.Seat.settled(int) runs back on the event thread. A newer watch(String) call drops the result. A count below 1 does not call NotebookDip.Seat.settled(int).

    • readCount

      private static int readCount(String text)
      The method posts the generate body and reads prompt_eval_count. The connect timeout is 4000 milliseconds. The read timeout is 20000 milliseconds. A status outside 200 through 299 returns 0. A missing stream returns 0. Any thrown exception returns 0. The connection is disconnected before the method returns.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the prompt sent in the body.
      Returns:
      The return value is the count, or 0 when the call fails.

    • bodyFor

      static String bodyFor(String text)
      The method builds the JSON body for one generate call. The model is MODEL. stream is false. keep_alive is 300. num_predict is 1.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the prompt placed in the JSON string.
      Returns:
      The return value is that JSON object.

    • jsonString

      static String jsonString(String text)
      The method quotes one string for JSON. A backslash or a quote is escaped with a backslash. A newline becomes \\n. A carriage return becomes \\r. A character below 0x20 becomes a space. Any other character is copied.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the prompt to quote.
      Returns:
      The return value is the quoted JSON string, including the quotes.

    • promptEvalCount

      static int promptEvalCount(String body)
      The method reads prompt_eval_count from a reply body. A null body returns 0. A missing key returns 0. Spaces, colons, and newlines after the key are skipped. The following digits are the count. No digit returns 0.
      Parameters:
      body - The body is the reply text, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the count, or 0 when the key is missing.
